title: System on Integrated Chips (SoIC(TM)) for 3D Heterogeneous Integration
notes: Platform overview: SoIC logic-on-logic in InFO_PoP; bond pitch sub-10 um; most benchmarks normalized to a typical 3DIC microbump stack; reliability pass/fail only.

title: RDL-1st Fan-Out Panel Level Packaging (FOPLP) for Heterogeneous and Economical Packaging
orgs: Institute of Microelectronics, A*STAR (Agency for Science, Technology and Research)
notes: RDL-first 2-layer Cu RDL on Gen 3 550x650 mm glass panel; LDI litho DOE, slit coat, PVD, ECP modules; 15x15 mm TV. No electrical/reliability data.

title: Advanced reliability study of TSV interposers and interconnects for the 28nm technology FPGA
notes: 4-slice 28 nm FPGA on 25x31 mm 100 um TSV interposer, 45 um ubump, 180 um C4, 42.5 mm substrate; ABAQUS warpage/fatigue; L5, HAST, 1000 TC.

title: Reliability Performance of Advanced Organic Interposer (CoWoS-R) Packages
notes: Two CoWoS-R packages (SOC+2 HBM2, 32x35 mm interposer; 2 SOC, 53x34 mm) pass TCC/TCG/uHAST/HTS; FE vs flip-chip BGA. 4 RDL, min 2/2 um.

title: InFO_oS (Integrated Fan-Out on Substrate) Technology for Advanced Chiplet Integration
orgs: Research and Development, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd.
notes: TSMC 2.5x reticle InFO_oS (51x42 mm) on 110x110 mm substrate, 2 logic + 8 IO, 5 RDL (2/2 x4, 5/5), 36 um D2D, 130 um C4; yield, warpage, SI/PI, reliability.
